notes.title: Patch 1.2.3 – RootMotion & Gore System Return
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/aad9bbaafd9077bf2cf4ce9c78b572e8681ba31e.png"][/img][/p][h3]Gameplay & Animations[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]RootMotion[/b] to player movement for smoother transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fully reworked [b]walk/run animations[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where stamina drained when stopping from a run.[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina now [b]regenerates 20% faster[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Strong Attack[/b] is easier to use and now shows a [b]charge effect[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]Story & Content[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]opening cutscenes[/b] (Act II only).[/p][/*][/list][h3]Locations & Enemies[/h3][list][*][p]Completely redesigned [b]Gatling Gun area[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Gatling Gun now fires [b]once every 3 seconds[/b] when spotting the player.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gore System is back[/b] – dismember enemy limbs if their HP drops below 300.[/p][/*][*][p]Shadow enemies (unseeable ones):[/p][list][*][p]No longer have collision.[/p][/*][*][p]Do not react to gunfire sounds like other enemies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted [b]lighting[/b] in several locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]collision issues[/b] in certain areas.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]☺️ Thank you for playing[/h3][p]We're still working! Game is builded and tested on PC with Intel I7, Geforce GT 1030, 16GB RAM and 2GB VRAM[/p][p]— [b]SATORI Ent. Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch to ver. 1.2.2.
notes.notes: [h3]Exploration & Progression[/h3][list][*][p][b]Rope Ascension removed:[/b] The old mechanic where you had to shoot to ascend with a rope has been completely removed. Instead, ladders are now placed throughout the levels.[/p][list][*][p]To climb: approach and press [b]E[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]To release the ladder: press [b]E[/b] again.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Boss Fights[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the size of the bosses [i]“Bridge Creature”[/i], [i]“Trinity Creature”[/i], and [i]“The Hanged”[/i] so they no longer block the camera view.[/p][/*][*][p]All enemies now properly register hits across their full mesh.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Enemies & World[/h3][list][*][p]Balcony enemies have been moved into a secret area.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Combat System[/h3][list][*][p][b]Parrying finalized:[/b] A feature from the earliest versions (0.8–0.9) has been fully reworked and polished.[/p][list][*][p]To parry: [b]shoot the enemy at the exact timing of their attack[/b]. This will put them into a stagger state.[/p][/*][*][p]While the enemy is staggered, perform a dash toward them and press [b]E[/b] to initiate a finishing move.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed blood effects on enemies. Pulled in older elements: enemies now leave blood pools, and parries/dealing damage cause more blood to appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the basic enemy attack chain: now more varied, with new thrusts and more dangerous follow-ups.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]stamina system[/b] has been added. Dodges, parries, and weapon attacks now consume stamina.[/p][/*][*][p]The stamina bar is displayed under the health bar.[/p][/*][*][p]When stamina is fully depleted, the character becomes temporarily vulnerable and cannot perform actions until it recovers.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapons & Balance[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted weapon durability: melee weapons no longer lose durability when swinging without hitting an enemy.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Achievements[/h3][list][*][p]Slightly reworked some Steam achievements and added a few new ones.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1][b]☺️ Thank you for playing[/b][/h1][p]We're still working! Game is builded and tested on PC with [i]Intel I7, Geforce GT 1030, 16GB RAM and 2GB VRAM[/i][/p][p][i]- SATORI Ent. Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Major Patch - ver. 1.2.
notes.notes:
[p][b]Update 1.2[/b] is here - a major August patch featuring gameplay improvements, a new location, controller support, boss overhaul, and more. But first, a quick update from the team:[/p][h2]Team Update[/h2][p]The BERENICE development team has recently gone from 6 to 3 people.
We’re now a compact trio: composer, programmer, and 3D artist - pushing forward together to polish the game and bring it to its full potential.
Thanks for your patience and continued support - we’re giving it everything we’ve got.[/p][p][i][u]Now let’s talk about what’s new[/u][/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/4366f7d9d4e30ddf3d364a3c6936b439f760f619.png"][/img][/p][h2]Controller Support[/h2][p]You can now fully play BERENICE using a controller:[/p][list][*][p]The entire game and menus are now controller-friendly[/p][/*][*][p]Control scheme is displayed in Settings -> Controller[/p][/*][*][p]We had to adjust the menu structure slightly to support this, but it should feel smoother overall[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Location - [b]Tears District[/b][/h2][p]A new area has been added before entering the Endless Palace: [b]Tears District[/b].
This will serve as a hub space, where quest-related characters will appear in future updates. For now - explore. Something’s already moving out there...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/19fd42d01283a4b57fa219cd311833806303cd55.png"][/img][/p][h2]Audio & Music Update[/h2][list][*][p]BERENICE’s singing has been reworked - richer, more haunting, closer to her intended sound[/p][/*][*][p]Ambient sound design added: background music now shifts depending on what spawns in the procedural room (enemies, upgrades, items)[/p][/*][/list][p]The result: a more reactive and layered atmosphere throughout.[/p][p][/p][h2]Performance Improvements & Optimization[/h2][list][*][p]Baked lighting in some areas[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced texture sizes[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified materials[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up level clutter and made some geometry more static
-> All of this gives a performance boost, especially on mid-range systems.[/p][p][b]But optimization is still ongoing.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Character Controls[/h2][list][*][p]Sprint is now toggled with a single press - no need to hold the button[/p][/*][*][p]Herman is no longer locked to camera movement - you can now turn and move freely[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Boss Model - [b]The Hunged One[/b] (Palace Vaults Section)[/h2][p]The boss in the Palace Vaults has been reworked to reflect the original artistic vision.
Meet [b]The Hung One[/b] - a towering four-legged creature suspended by hundreds of wires in a frozen illusion of order. A monstrous relic of architectural obsession.[/p][quote][p]Its cracked skin reveals ropes and hooks instead of muscle.
The skull is bare - stretched like a spire.
Once a symbol of stability, now a grotesque monument to control and decay.[/p][/quote][p][/p][h2]Balance Tweak[/h2][list][*][p][b]Mayor of Edinburgh[/b] now heals much less - the fight is more fair and intense.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Visual Touches[/h2][list][*][p]Small art and lighting improvements across several areas[/p][/*][*][p]Minor refinements to level composition (no spoilers)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Localization Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Most issues with [b]English–Russian localization[/b] have been resolved.
Menus, settings, UI, and in-game texts should now display correctly depending on your language selection.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1]☺️ Thank you for playing[/h1][p]We're still working — but this is a big step forward.
Let us know what you think of 1.2 in the discussions - we read everything.[/p][p][i]- SATORI Ent. Team[/i][/p]

First Official Gameplay Video[/h3][p]We’ve just published the [b]first official gameplay video[/b] of [i]BERENICE[/i] on our YouTube channel -[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/Jk9AJtVhBYI?si=HNdnw8Npz-7EzKA-"][/dynamiclink]In this video, you’ll get a look at:

- The core combat and atmosphere of the game[/p][p][/p][p]The footage was captured on [b]Medium settings[/b] in version [b]1.1.5[/b]
🖥️ Test PC specs:
CPU: Ryzen 5 5600
GPU: RX 6700 XT
RAM: 16GB
VRAM: 12GB[/p][hr][/hr][h3]2. English Version of the Official Website[/h3][p]Our [url="https://sat-ent.com"]SATORI website[/url] is now available in [b]English[/b]![/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/fe3a8f45a9ce977a2f308ef5e9c86f02b6dc01d7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/853ff11f34bbc9598ae4a6e2905763957b06d578.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]We’ll start posting dev updates and news there soon, but for now, you can:
- Learn about the studio and the team
- Explore our past work
- Listen to the [b]full soundtracks[/b] from all our games, including BERENICE[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for following our journey - we’re building this world with everything we’ve got.
See you in the halls of the Palace.[/p][p][i]-SATORI team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Major Update - Patch 1.1.5!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/e1a238764adae1c556212e58efc57a45e288b364.png"][/img][/p][p]What if the world had no boundaries — and the mind, no escape?
The Endless Palace continues to grow.
The immersion is deeper. The illusions are sharper.
The path to Berenice is darker than ever.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Major changes:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/18a09fe591cfd08853c256e6e3c297547992678c.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Facial animations for Berenice - she’s closer than she seems.[/p][/*][*][p]Final cutscene reworked - the ending now hits harder[/p][/*][*][p]New soundtrack added - the Main Theme and other tracks are now available at [url="https://sat-ent.com"]sat-ent.com[/url][/p][/*][*][p]UI updated - a new font enhances atmosphere and readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Water physics implemented - the depths of the sunken city now truly come alive.[/p][/*][*][p]Map update - a hidden location and secret boss have been added.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Weapon system update:[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578672/59dcfe504b6e3c79236b0f86974016a09155f1c6.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Weapons can now be picked up and discarded.[/p][/*][*][p]Each weapon has its own durability bar - nothing lasts forever.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New weapons:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shotgun - high power for close-range combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Sawblade sword - tears through enemies, but demands control.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Core change:[/b][/p][p]The Palace is now truly endless.
It is no longer limited by borders or patterns.
Move forward, and the architecture reshapes around you.
Follow the voice of Berenice...
But beware - each biome now holds its own boss.
Victory is not an exit. It is only the next corridor.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Coming soon:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hotfixes[/p][/*][*][p]New procedural content within the Palace[/p][/*][*][p]More lore fragments, puzzles, and distortions of logic[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for walking this path with us.
Even if it leads nowhere.
- the SATORI team[/p]
